market.claim: Small local models reduce inference cost and data exposure for narrow enterprise tasks.
Model routing can reserve stronger models for high-marginal-gain requests.

systems.claim: PEFT reduces trainable parameter count and adapter storage compared with full fine-tuning.
Quantization can reduce memory but requires task-specific regression testing.

risk.claim: Multi-agent systems require bounded communication and tool permissions to control coordination overhead.
Private local data does not automatically make a model safe from memorization or leakage.
